models.notes: SCUNet blind real-world denoising (PSNR variant). Removes sensor noise, JPEG artifacts, grain while preserving detail. Trained on synthetic data — works on real photos without paired training. Input: [1,3,H,W] float32 [0,1], H and W divisible by 64 (dynamic). Output: same shape denoised. ~70MB. Source: Heliosoph/scunet-onnx (HuggingFace), Apache-2.0. Converted from cszn/SCUNet (Zhang et al. 2022). Default variant: general-purpose photo denoising. Padding contract corrected 2026-08-13: the graph’s baked window-8 attention reshape crashes unless padded dims are multiples of 64 (verified by dimension sweep).

validation.validationSummary: Reproducible conversion from the official NAFNet-GoPro-width64 checkpoint (tools/nafnet-export): bit-exact parity with the trusted PyTorch reference on real photos (max diff <= 1/255), dynamic shape, fp16 internal weights with fp32 boundary. GoPro test-set PSNR gate recorded in docs/quality/image-enhancement-benchmark.md.

models.notes: NAFNet-GoPro-width64 motion/defocus deblurring. Task-validated for deblur only; not advertised for denoise or JPEG restoration. BGR channel order (official OpenCV training convention; the runtime swaps at the boundary). H/W divisible by 16. MIT (c) 2022 megvii-model. ~138MB fp16 single-file.

SAM2.1 Hiera Tiny — interactive object segmentation via point/box prompts. Two-stage: image encoder (1024x1024) + prompt/mask decoder. Verified source: vietanhdev/segment-anything-2-onnx-models (HuggingFace, Apache-2.0). Composite download is the verified encoder + decoder pair; separate ONNX graphs are loaded by the worker.

components.notes: Graph repaired for onnxruntime-web: the upstream export declares empty value_info shapes on /conv_s0 and /conv_s1 outputs, which ort-web's wasm shape inference rejects at session creation (inferred=4 declared=0). Repair is reproducible via scripts/models/repair-sam2-graph.mjs and was verified bit-identical against the upstream graph (ort-node encode outputs match to the last digit).

models.notes: AI depth estimation — powers Depth Blur's depth-aware background blur. Verified source: onnx-community/depth-anything-v2-small on Hugging Face (Apache-2.0, converted from the official depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small checkpoint). Using the INT8 variant (~27MB) over FP32 (~99MB) to keep the one-time download reasonable on constrained connections and 4GB-RAM devices. Input: 518x518 RGB letterboxed (multiple of 14). Output: relative depth map, raw convention nearIsHigh. Normalization: ImageNet (mean=[0.485,0.456,0.406], std=[0.229,0.224,0.225]).

Finds people and objects in a photo with bounding boxes across 80 everyday categories — powers subject-aware crop/resize and a standalone detection overlay. Verified 2026-07-21 by downloading and inspecting the real graph (opset 12): pixel_values [B,3,800,800] float32 + pixel_mask [B,64,64] int64 -> logits [B,100,92], pred_boxes [B,100,4] normalized cx/cy/w/h.

models.notes: Classifies a photo's content for automatic tagging and organization across 1000 ImageNet classes. Verified 2026-07-21: NHWC [1,224,224,3] float32 input (TF-native layout, not the usual NCHW), preprocessing (pixel-127)/128, Softmax:0 [1,1000] output. Opset 11.

Removes an unwanted object or blemish and fills the gap with plausible generated content, guided by a mask you paint. Verified 2026-07-21 by downloading and inspecting the real graph (opset 17): TWO separate named inputs image [B,3,512,512] + mask [B,1,512,512] float32 (not a stacked 4-channel tensor as some secondhand descriptions claim); output already scaled to 0-255. Large (~208MB) — offered as an optional download.

Generates an in-between frame from two keyframes for smoother Motion-mode playback and timeline scrubbing. Verified 2026-07-21 by downloading and inspecting the real graph (single dynamic-shape input, no fixed dims declared) — channel convention (frame0+frame1 RGB stacked, no separate img0/img1 inputs as some secondhand descriptions claim) follows the standard RIFE export convention but is NOT confirmed against a reference runtime; treat interpolation quality as unverified until checked against known-good output.

Local image embeddings for visual similarity search. Exact artifact verified 2026-08-13: pixel_values [1,3,224,224] float32 -> last_hidden_state [1,197,384] float32; the first 384 values are the CLS embedding. DINOv2 preprocessing uses shortest-side 256 resize, center crop to 224, ImageNet normalization, and RGB channel order.

Embeds an image so visually/semantically similar assets can be ranked and surfaced (Embeds an image so visually/semantically similar assets can be ranked and surfaced; the same artifact also provides the paired text tower used by natural-language queries (see siglip-base-patch16-224-text). Graph contract re-verified 2026-08-13 against this exact artifact: pixel_values [B,3,224,224] float32 -> image_embeds [B,768]; input_ids [B,T] int64 is graph-required and fed as a constant zero). Graph contract re-verified 2026-08-13 against this exact artifact: pixel_values [B,3,224,224] float32 -> image_embeds [B,768]; input_ids [B,T] int64 is graph-required and fed as a constant zero token. SigLIP normalizes to mean=0.5/std=0.5 per channel, not ImageNet stats.

Text-side SigLIP encoder for local natural-language image search. It shares the 768-dimensional embedding space with siglip-base-patch16-224 image embeddings. Requires the pinned tokenizer.json asset; download is explicit and cached locally.

SigLIP T5-style SentencePiece Unigram tokenizer vocabulary and normalizer charsmap. Pinned from the reference implementation's tokenizer.json; the TypeScript tokenizer reproduces its normalizer chain and Viterbi exactly (parity-tested against transformers).

Highlights where text appears in an image — useful for redaction, accessibility review, and as a first stage toward full OCR. Detection only (recognition + character dictionary not yet wired up). Verified 2026-07-21 by downloading and inspecting the real graph (opset 11): x [B,3,H,W] float32 fully dynamic -> sigmoid_0.tmp_0 [B,1,H,W] per-pixel text probability map.
